cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only useful for carrying boxes. You could finally give your tools a proper home if you sorted the shed; I'll clear you a wall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Until you dump paint tins there again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put the paint outside. You can label the wall, and I'll keep every shelf to your layout.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Including one shelf you're forbidden to touch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The whole top shelf, if that makes it worth doing. I'll move my drill tonight and make that your space. Shall I leave the labels with you?

reason: S06 mechanism transition: replace abstract no-charge/right-outcome tags with a modest social role and actual choices that determine the outcome. Preserve responsive canonical Drive causality and repair only dialogue delivery or weak combined method.
